title: Why Does AI Make Things Up?
meta:
9:16 · 1080×1920 · 30 fps · ~1:02 (estimated timing)
Look: archive & horizon (different from EP001)
Narration: ElevenLabs “Brian” (pending) · Music & SFX: original

shots.vo: Ask an AI for a source,
shots.shot: In a glowing archive of bookshelves, Ivo happily hands over a paper citation (book icon, title, author, page).

shots.vo: …and it might give you one that doesn't exist. Title, author, even page numbers.
shots.shot: Close-up on the paper citation: title, author and page get highlighted one by one, then the paper flickers.
A slate "no" ring draws over the citation as it fades away. It doesn't exist.

shots.vo: It isn't lying. It's doing what it was built to do.
shots.shot: Ivo shrugs and shakes his head, then explains with open hands; paper word strips drift behind him.

shots.vo: Here's why AI sometimes makes things up.
shots.shot: Close-up in the archive, hand to chin, slow push-in; whip-pan out.

shots.vo: A language model writes by predicting the next token…
shots.shot: A glowing orb (the model) with orbiting rings; paper word strips drop in one by one: "The study was published in ___".

shots.vo: Facts that appeared again and again leave strong patterns…
shots.shot: On the horizon floor, a wide bright road lined with many papers leads to a glowing beacon with a check mark.

shots.vo: But rare facts… leave weak patterns.
shots.shot: The camera pans to a single paper on a faint dashed trail that fades into fog, ending at a dim "?".

shots.vo: …so it writes what a right answer would sound like.
shots.shot: The empty strip fills with a confident orange "2019"; Ivo looks pleased.
The sentence becomes a mirage: its reflection ripples like heat haze. Ivo is startled, then confused.

shots.vo: Many tests… reward a confident guess over "I'm not sure."
shots.shot: A paper exam: "Guess" is ticked and gets an orange +1 stamp; "I'm not sure" gets a grey 0. Ivo is confused.

shots.vo: Tools that search the web or your documents first can help.
shots.shot: A radar sweep finds real sources: orange blips light up one by one.

shots.vo: But no AI is right every time.
shots.shot: One blip stays grey with a "?"; Ivo appears, thinking.

shots.vo: So use AI for ideas and drafts.
shots.shot: Ivo presents a paper card with a lightbulb (ideas and drafts).

shots.vo: For facts that matter, check the source, and make sure it's real.
shots.shot: A source paper slides in and gets an orange ✓ stamp; Ivo nods happily.
End card: Ivo waves, then "Follow Ask Ivo" and "for the next video".
